items.question: What does the Petroleum Institute's student exchange programme in Abu Dhabi offer visiting students?
items.gold: The opportunity to experience the UAE while gaining transferable credits towards their engineering degree.
items.fact: Petroleum Institute exchange gives visitors transferable engineering degree credits

items.question: Which US Government-sponsored exchange programme links Emirati citizens and Americans?
items.fact: Fulbright Program links Emiratis and Americans through exchange
